subtitleNullable: Stack-ready OOF/test predictions on the shared seed-42 5-fold split
descriptionNullable:
Out-of-fold (OOF) and test predictions of 7 models for Kaggle Playground Series S6E10 (binary `satisfaction`,
ROC AUC), all on the shared split `StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)` over `train.csv` row order.

**The TABPFN-3.5 Model is licensed by Prior Labs GmbH under the TABPFN-3.5 Non-Commercial License.** See https://huggingface.co/Prior-Labs/tabpfn_3_5 for the license. The `tabpfn_catfd10` files contain prediction outputs of
TabPFN-3.5, not model weights. Their use is subject to the license's output restrictions, including non-commercial,
non-production use and the prohibition on using outputs to train competitive models; please read the license (including
who may use the model) before reusing them. Anything stacked from these files inherits those restrictions.

## Terms of use
* The dataset license is "other" because the files have different terms. The `license` column of `members.csv` names
  the upstream software/model licenses; it is not a blanket license for the prediction files.
* `oof_tabpfn_catfd10.npy`, `test_tabpfn_catfd10.npy`: TabPFN-3.5 output restrictions above.
* All other files (our own predictions, ids/folds, metadata): CC BY 4.0, from us.
* All files are derived from the S6E10 competition data and remain subject to the competition rules.

## Files
* `oof_<tag>.npy` - float32, length 699,635, **train.csv row order**; row i is predicted by the model of the fold where i was in validation.
* `test_<tag>.npy` - float32, length 299,844, **test.csv row order**; mean of the 5 fold models' probabilities.
* `train_ids_folds.csv` - `id`, `fold` for every train row (the split above); `test_ids.csv` - test ids in order.
* `members.csv` - one row per member: model, inputs, training protocol, OOF and per-fold AUC, runtime, license, hashes.

## Members
| tag | model | OOF AUC | runtime | license |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `tabpfn_catfd10` | TabPFN-3.5 (tabpfn 9.1.0, ckpt tabpfn-v3.5-20260909), n_estimators=1 | 0.961178 | 42 min for 5 folds on one RTX 4090 (fit ~5 min/fold + predict 140k val + 300k test rows) | TABPFN-3.5 Non-Commercial License (Prior Labs GmbH); outputs for non-commercial use only |
| `tabicl_fdcat_c250k` | TabICL v2 (tabicl 2.2.0, ckpt tabicl-classifier-v2-20260212), 1 estimator | 0.957281 | 6 min for 5 folds on one RTX 4090 | TabICL code and weights: BSD-3-Clause |
| `rmlp_f_nc` | RealMLP (pytabkit 1.7.3, RealMLP_TD_Classifier), yekenot settings, n_ens=8, flat_anneal | 0.961295 | 14 min for 5 folds on one RTX 4090 | pytabkit: Apache-2.0 |
| `tabm_bcd_rc_v2` | TabM (pytabkit 1.7.3, TabM_D_Classifier, k=32, PWL embeddings) | 0.960768 | 107 min for 5 folds on a shared RTX 4090 (about 6 min/fold when the GPU was free) | pytabkit: Apache-2.0 |
| `lgb_w1` | LightGBM, num_leaves 127, lr 0.015, 1084 rounds | 0.961198 | 4.5 min for 5 folds on CPU (both passes; features cached) | LightGBM: MIT |
| `xgb_w1` | XGBoost hist, depth 8, lr 0.01, 1438 rounds | 0.961197 | about 5 min for 5 folds (refit pass; features cached) | XGBoost: Apache-2.0 |
| `cat_w1` | CatBoost GPU, depth 8, lr 0.06, l2 10, 1636 rounds | 0.961223 | 38 min for 5 folds on a shared RTX 4090 | CatBoost: Apache-2.0 |

## Caveats
* Training excludes each row's outer-fold label, but configuration selection used these folds. LightGBM/XGBoost round
  counts came from five-fold early stopping; CatBoost's count came from fold 0. TabM early-stops on an inner holdout from
  the training folds; RealMLP trains a fixed number of epochs. These OOF AUCs are not independent estimates.
* Fold-safe TE excludes outer-validation labels, although its inner smoothing prior uses the full outer-training set.
* Label-free preprocessing (route profiles, value counts, aux-task features) uses all competition features, including
  outer-validation and test rows; auxiliary cross-fitting uses a separate split. Lookup/teacher features use labels of
  the original 129,880-row dataset only; we did not audit overlap with competition rows.
* Verify `id`/`fold` against your own split before stacking. Matching splitter settings alone does not guarantee identical folds.

## Credits
This reproduces established modelling ideas; our part is running them on the shared split, the measurements and the
packaging. TabPFN-3.5 by Prior Labs; TabICL v2 (Qu et al.); RealMLP and TabM via pytabkit (Holzmüller et al.; TabM by
Gorishniy et al.); RealMLP settings from yekenot's public notebook. Flight Distance as a categorical route key for TabPFN,
route-profile and aux-task features follow goodpjw2008's public notebooks; original-data lookup/teacher features follow
evgendvorkin and goodpjw2008 (credited in our feature-ladder notebook). Original data:
arseniyshutko/binary-aviation-satisfaction-129k (displayed license CC0-1.0, checked 2026-10-09), derived from TJ Klein's
Airline Passenger Satisfaction dataset. Code and full description: https://www.kaggle.com/code/koumeimaki/tabpfn-3-5-full-context-on-one-gpu-oof-dataset
